title: Elite: The Crowd Names the Trial: Threshold Sign
description: The Crowd Names the Trial unfolds across floating marble arena with bronze laurel circles and crowd-shadow platforms, pushing a 5-Titan Olympian squad to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Crowd Names the Trial: Threshold Sign advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
terrain: floating marble arena with bronze laurel circles and crowd-shadow platforms
